title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover ordering
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Urgent hotfix to address two production issues observed during the 2026-02-17 incident: (1) the SLO enforcer backoff logic occasionally deadlocked under concurrent regional failover signals causing prolonged client 5xxs, and (2) region-to-region failover ordering could race with the circuit-breaker state machine, leading to cascading load-shedding in healthy regions. This PR stabilizes the backoff state machine, introduces ordering guarantees for failover signals, tightens hysteresis for circuit breaker transitions, and adds defensive metrics and tests. Key changes: 1) move backoff state transitions to a single-threaded enforcer loop with an async work-queue to avoid concurrent mutation; 2) attach monotonic sequence IDs to regional-failover events and reject out-of-order processing; 3) add short-term grace window (+ jitter) when promoting a region to active to avoid immediate load-shedding thrash; 4) add integration tests that simulate concurrent failover+backoff; 5) add additional debug metrics and tracing spans for backoff/failover decisions. This description includes implementation notes, testing, rollout plan, and rollback instructions in a single continuous string as required.

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover ordering. Fixes a deadlock in SLO backoff state, prevents out-of-order regional failovers, and reduces risk of cascading load-shedding. Recommended: monitor backoff_decision and failover_sequence metrics after deploy.
testing_and_validation: Unit tests added for backoff state transitions; new integration test simulates concurrent failover+backoff and validated readiness on a 3-region local cluster. Load test: 30m soak with synthetic traffic including failover bursts; no regression in P50/P95 latency and SLO enforcement behaved as expected.
rollout_plan: Canary rollout to 10% of traffic in us-east-1 for 30m, monitor backoff_decision, failover_sequence, errors/5xx, and client latency. If stable, expand to 50% for 1h, then full rollout. Abort and rollback if 5xx rate increases above 0.5% or if failover_sequence shows repeated rejections.
rollback_instructions: Rollback to tag main@20260217 and disable regional automatic failover (feature flag) if necessary. Run runbook steps: (1) disable enforcer enablement flag, (2) notify SRE, (3) revert DB migration if metric scraping is impacted.
